import ast,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
R=Path('/workspace/jiaoyi-monday-18470')
e=json.loads((R/'evidence.json').read_text())
m=json.loads((R/'monitor.json').read_text())
tree=ast.parse(Path('/workspace/jiaoyi-forensic-18406/analyse.py').read_text())
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='pb'],type_ignores=[]),'decoder','exec'))
def dt(x):return datetime.fromisoformat(x.replace('Z','+00:00'))
def cash(d):
    v=[d[k] for k in ('close_gross_profit','close_swap','close_commission','close_pnl_conversion_fee')]
    assert all(type(a)==int for a in v)
    return float((Decimal(v[0])+Decimal(v[1])-abs(Decimal(v[2]))-abs(Decimal(v[3])))/Decimal(10)**d['close_money_digits'])
rows=[]
for o in e['orders']:
    if o['kind']!='open':continue
    f=next((f for f in e['fills'] if f['entry_key']==o['entry_key'] and f['outcome']=='filled'),None)
    if not f:continue
    pid,aid=f['position_id'],o['account_id']
    ds=[d for d in e['deals'] if (d['account_id'],d['position_id'])==(aid,pid)]
    en=[d for d in ds if not d['is_closing']];ex=[d for d in ds if d['is_closing']]
    assert len(en)==1 and len(ex)<=1 and en[0]['filled_volume']==f['volume']
    if ex:assert ex[0]['filled_volume']==f['volume']
    en,ex=en[0],ex[0] if ex else None;brackets=[]
    for ev in e['events']:
        if (ev['account_id'],ev['position_id'])!=(aid,pid) or ev['payload_type']!=2126:continue
        b=pb(bytes.fromhex(ev['raw_hex']));p=pb(b[4]) if 4 in b else {};order=pb(b[5]) if 5 in b else {}
        brackets.append({'id':ev['id'],'at':ev['received_at'],'kind':ev['kind'],'label':ev['label'],'sl':p.get(6),'tp':p.get(7),'closing_order':bool(order.get(12)),'order_type':order.get(3)})
    initial=next(b for b in brackets if b['sl'] is not None and b['tp'] is not None)
    g=next(json.loads(bytes.fromhex(v['raw_hex'])) for v in e['events'] if v['entry_key']==o['entry_key'] and v['kind']=='ENTRY_VALIDATED_BEFORE_SEND')
    d=o['detail'];side=o['side'];sign=1 if side=='buy' else -1;risk=d['entry']['r'];fx=d['quote_to_deposit'];risk_cash=risk*f['volume']/100*fx
    lastsl=next(b['sl'] for b in reversed(brackets) if b['sl'] is not None)
    closing_orders=[z for z in e['orders'] if (z['account_id'],z['position_id'])==(aid,pid) and z['kind'] not in ('open','trail')]
    if ex is None:reason='open'
    elif any(z['kind']=='session_end' and any(ff['entry_key']==z['entry_key'] and ff['outcome']=='filled' for ff in e['fills']) for z in closing_orders):reason='native_session_end'
    elif sign*(ex['execution_price']-initial['tp'])>=-1e-6:reason='broker_protective_fill_at_or_better_than_tp'
    elif abs(lastsl-en['execution_price'])<1e-6:reason='breakeven_stop_with_fill_slippage'
    elif sign*(ex['execution_price']-lastsl)<=1e-6:reason='initial_stop_loss'
    else:reason='broker_protective_exit_unresolved_classification'
    proof=g['pullback_admitted_price']['confirmed_turn'];peer=g['peer'];peer_bps=sign*((peer['bid']+peer['ask'])/2-peer['origin'])/peer['origin']*10000
    turn=sign*((proof['confirmed_bid']+proof['confirmed_ask'])/2-proof['turn_extreme'])/abs(proof['extreme']-proof['origin'])
    assert peer_bps>=24 and turn>=.08-1e-6 and abs(abs(initial['sl']-en['execution_price'])-risk)<1e-6
    assert all(b['label']=='jiaoyi-s3' for b in brackets)
    rows.append({'account_id':aid,'symbol':o['symbol'],'symbol_id':o['symbol_id'],'position_id':pid,'entry_key':o['entry_key'],'side':side,'policy':d['production_policy'],'entry_at':en['executed_at'],'exit_at':ex['executed_at'] if ex else None,'entry_fill':en['execution_price'],'exit_fill':ex['execution_price'] if ex else None,'native_volume':f['volume'],'volume_limits':d['volume_limits'],'quote_to_deposit':fx,'risk_price':risk,'initial_risk_usd':risk_cash,'initial_sl':initial['sl'],'initial_tp':initial['tp'],'last_recorded_sl':lastsl,'exit_reason':reason,'net_usd':cash(ex) if ex else None,'net_r':cash(ex)/risk_cash if ex else None,'in_requested_window':bool(ex and dt('2026-11-15T23:15:00Z')<=dt(ex['executed_at'])<dt('2026-11-16T07:25:00Z')),'new_in_requested_window':dt('2026-11-15T23:15:00Z')<=dt(en['executed_at'])<dt('2026-11-16T07:25:00Z'),'carryover_from_18420':False,'entry_slippage_price':f['slippage'],'order_to_fill_ms':f['latency_ms'],'confirmation_to_guard_ms':(dt(g['checked_at'])-dt(proof['confirmed_at'])).total_seconds()*1000,'peer_signed_bps':peer_bps,'turn_fraction':turn,'initial_cost':d['cost'],'entry_geometry':d['entry'],'margin':d.get('prepared_admission',{}).get('margin'),'cash_receipts':ds,'protection_events':brackets,'guard':g})
(R/'trade-ledger.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
